rationale: Selected on rebalance-phase STABILITY, not on the maximum of a phase distribution. Across 6 semiannual and 3 quarterly rebalance phases COMP_allweather has PNL std Rs24-30L vs Rs67-84L for every momentum rival, the shallowest max drawdown (-27.2%), and four economically distinct legs each defensible in one sentence. Rivals scoring higher (mom_12m Rs427L) do so only at their best phase and collapse ~50% at their worst.
